pulse_editorial.summary: Attention over the last month has noticeably pulled back from discussions on quantum resistance, which saw the largest decrease in engagement. Concurrently, contributors are dedicating more discussion bandwidth to transaction privacy and core UTXO management challenges.
insights: The most significant shift in focus over the past 30 days has been an organic decline in discussions around quantum resistance, signaling a period of reduced immediate urgency in this area.

A concrete proposal currently gaining traction is the `[BIP Draft] Segregated Data` (topic_2641), which suggests a soft-forkable block region for arbitrary, non-monetary data, with an option for nodes not to store it.

An enduring, unresolved question continues to be how the Bitcoin network will sustainably incentivize miners and maintain security as the block subsidy diminishes over time, prompting a wide range of ideas from fee market evolution to alternative inflation schedules.
